visual_action: A slideshow contrasts screenshots of tweets from a fictional news source called 'FactPost'. The first section, titled 'when democrats are in office', shows three positive 'news' items about Democratic governors Andy Beshear and Gavin Newsom, and Mayor Zohran Mamdani, related to pre-K, libraries, and free diapers. These slides are accompanied by a large, smiling emoji graphic. The second section, titled 'when republicans are in office', shows one negative 'news' item about Republicans voting against a ban on child marriage. This slide is accompanied by a nervous, grimacing emoji graphic.
